receipt.public_excerpt: The US government, citing national security authorities, has issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, whether inside or outside the United States, including foreign national Anthropic employees.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic confirms an export control directive to suspend all access to both models by foreign nationals, including its own employees. Marcus's quote matches this text.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic was forced to disable all access to its newest AI models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, late on Friday after the U.S. Commerce Department used national security export controls to bar the company from distributing the models to any foreign national.

evidence_items.explanation: Fortune names the Commerce Department as the issuer of the export control directive.

receipt.public_excerpt: The directive includes not just people located outside the U.S., but also any foreign national in the U.S., including Anthropic’s own non-citizen employees.

evidence_items.explanation: Fortune independently confirms that the directive covered Anthropic's own foreign-national employees.
